completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).

stopConditions: Probe breaker (S1): a family fails a stage on its first-probe candidate and then on its single retry; the family parks, the park is recorded in explorations/semantica-lab/DECISIONS.md, and the exploration drops back to decompose. Never a calendar.
C1 cannot start until the sibling openai-driver packet has merged (completion gate satisfied and the PR landed on main); C0 and the scaffold never wait on it.

A change would cross a SPEC non-goal (window, sidecar/IPC, local models, consumption-side retrieval, atlas backlog, NET-NEW reasoning runtime, reusable lab export) or touch a brick outside cleanup-on-touch.
A stage pass criterion cannot be measured as a lab test or CLI run.
Verification requires credentials, cost, destructive side effects, or policy approval not named in SPEC.md.
An adopt or pick-one value would be written to the Notion atlas before its canary stage passes.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.
